neighbours.label: Oils and fatty acids as substances (olive oil, crude oil, oleic acid, trans fats), vs the same frames with a non-lipid substance
fire: Coconut oil is high in saturated fat, mostly lauric acid.
Walnuts contain alpha-linolenic acid, an omega-3 fatty acid.
The soap is made by boiling palm oil with lye.
Linseed oil slowly hardens as it reacts with air.
Butter contains small amounts of natural trans fatty acids.
Tankers carried crude oil from the gulf to the refineries.
Frying in sunflower oil adds linoleic acid to the diet.
The cream is made from shea butter and jojoba oil.
quiet: Coconut water is high in potassium, mostly from the pulp.
Walnuts contain magnesium, a mineral needed for muscles.
The soap is made by mixing goat milk with honey.
Wet clay slowly hardens as it dries in air.
Butter contains small amounts of natural vitamin A.
Tankers carried fresh water from the gulf to the islands.
Frying in a steel pan adds iron to the diet.
The cream is made from aloe gel and rose water.
